review.tagline: Desktop app that switches API providers for coding agents and manages their MCP and skills
review.summary: CC Switch is a Tauri 2 desktop app written in Rust for Windows, macOS and Linux. It switches API providers for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Pi and MiniMax Code. It also manages MCP servers, Skills and Prompts in one place, so JSON, TOML and YAML configs need no hand-editing.
review.audience: Developers who use several coding agents and rotate API providers
strengths: Covers ten coding agents and CLIs from one provider switcher
Manages MCP servers, Skills and Prompts alongside provider settings
Native desktop builds for Windows, macOS and Linux via Tauri 2
MIT license, with a user manual and translated READMEs
weaknesses: README opens with a long list of API relay sponsors and referral links
Desktop GUI only; no Docker image or headless mode detected
Part of the README was truncated, so install and feature details are unverified
System requirements such as minimum RAM are unknown
needs: Models: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build
